name: loom-memory
description: Optional, passively-triggered repository-memory capability with an OKF v0.2-compatible store profile. Installs and works standalone — no dependency on loom-code, loom-design, or loom-workflow. Claude Code + Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Optional OKF-compatible repository memory, for Codex CLI
interface.longDescription: loom-memory is a standalone, independently installable repository-memory capability: a public skill that recalls, records, reconciles, and retires repository knowledge on request or when an agent identifies a concrete need for prior experience — never because a Loom station was merely reached. Its generated store is OKF v0.2 conformant: every non-reserved document carries parseable YAML frontmatter with a non-empty type, and the reserved index.md and log.md files follow their reserved structure. loom-memory declares no mandatory dependency on loom-code, loom-design, or loom-workflow, and none of those plugins depends on it — any of them, or a user working without any of them, can invoke the same public memory skill. Verdicts on what it produces are never rendered here.
defaultPrompt: Remember what we learned from this.
What do we already know about this problem?
Reconcile the memory store with what's true now.
